messages:
tara_am: Heads-up — CognitoHealth's renewal invoice INV-2026-0897 is blocked. Customer says they submitted PO but our system shows no PO on file, plus last card attempt was declined. They're asking for Net 45 instead of upfront. Can we triage?

jessica_support: Thanks @tara_am. I pulled the invoice: amount $42,300, VAT EU mismatch flagged (company VAT id looks UK, billing address FR). Payment attempt id: pay_9483 failed. Customer message: 'we can approve Net terms if PO is on the invoice and VAT is corrected' — they need access restored by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

oleg_billing: Repro steps from billing side: 1) invoice created by billing job 2026-03-12 14:22Z, 2) no PO field present, 3) payment attempt pay_9483 returned decline. Here's the raw failure from PSP:```{
  "status":"failed",
  "code":"card_declined",
  "decline_reason":"do_not_honor"
}```

mike_finance: If they're asking Net 45 that's an ARR change. Need finance approval + risk check. Any previous credit for CognitoHealth?

jessica_support: They had Net 30 previously for a pilot in 2024, but no formal Net terms in 2025. Sales (tara) says legal signed an SOW but finance never onboarded net terms. 

tara_am: Correct — SOW references PO flow but ops missed adding PO template to invoice generation. Customer provided PO #CH-77654 in email thread. I can attach it to the invoice once approved.

finance-bot: [automated] Invoice INV-2026-0897 status: PAYMENT_FAILED. Attempts: 1. pay_9483 (card_declined). Tax validation: VAT MISMATCH for billed_country=FR vs vat_country=GB.

mike_finance: Two asks from finance: (1) confirm reliable PO on record and attach to invoice, (2) run tax re-validation after fixing VAT id. If risk is acceptable, approve provisional Net 45 for this invoice only and require card on file for future. Sam, legal ok with one-off? @sam_legal

sam_legal: I can sign off on a one-off Net 45 for this customer pending PO attachment and an acceptance clause in email thread. Will add clause: 'payment due within 45 days; non-payment may trigger suspension'. Need copy of PO and customer's billing contact.

oleg_billing: I've run a VAT check tool — the VAT id appears valid but country mismatch likely from address formatting. I will re-run validation after tara uploads corrected billing address and VAT id to the invoice metadata.

jessica_support: Action items: Tara to attach PO CH-77654 & corrected VAT details; Oleg to revalidate taxes and attempt a manual charge after PO present; Mike to approve provisional Net 45 in finance system; Sam to sign legal note. I'll keep the customer updated: will say 'we can provisionally approve Net 45 subject to PO and VAT verification — working on it now.' 

tara_am: Attaching PO and corrected VAT to the support ticket now (see link to email thread). I've updated invoice metadata: PO=CH-77654, billing_vat=GB999999973.

oleg_billing: Revalidated VAT -> success. Will requeue manual charge attempt in 15m. If charge still declined we should accept Net 45 and mark invoice as 'pending terms' to unblock access.

mike_finance: I approved a one-off Net 45 for INV-2026-0897 in the finance portal (ticket FIN-4521). Conditions: PO must remain attached, send reminder at day 30, and require card update. Please log that in the account. :white_check_mark:

jessica_support: Noted. I'll tell CognitoHealth the one-off Net 45 is approved, payment window 45 days, account remains active. Also asking them to update card details to avoid future holds. Draft reply: 'we've provisionally approved Net 45 for INV-2026-0897 pending VAT verification and PO (attached). Please update card on file to avoid suspension.' Anyone want to tweak?

sam_legal: Draft looks fine. Add: 'this exception does not set precedent for future invoices.'

tara_am: Messaging sent to customer, they replied :thumbsup: and confirmed they will update card by EOW. Closing internal loop once payment or updated card lands.

jessica_support: Closing thread. Summary saved to ticket SUP-3127: one-off Net 45 approved, PO attached, VAT resolved, finance ticket FIN-4521, account remains active until 2026-04-27.

oleg_billing: Logged invoice events and final status. If manual charge fails again, we escalate to collections and re-evaluate terms.

mike_finance: Thanks team.
